FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE RAJGAMA PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political party to which KandageSharmi Anushka Kumari De Silva the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaidordinance, to decide upon returned member if United National Party who belongs to such party and is not disqualifiedunder Section 9 of the local authorities election ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within aperiod of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision tonominate Siriyawathi Suwaris Abeysekara to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Malawenna Godage Lalith Ananda, Returning Officer of the Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatSiriyawathi Suwaris Abeysekara was selected as the member of the Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha.
M. G. LALITH ANANDA,Returning Officer,Rajgama Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Election Office,Galle,08th August, 2018.

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE MANMUNAI WESTPRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) (a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Manmunai West Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the IIankai Tamil Arasu Kadchi, the recognized political party to whichAriyarethinam Mahesarajah the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) (a) of the aforesaidordinance, to decide upon the member of that 1 Mahilawadduwan if Manmunai West Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs tosuch party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the local authorities election ordinance and who shall be declaredselected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision tonominate Alagaiah Amirthalingam to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Rajendra Saseelan, Returning Officer of the Manmunai West Pradeshiya Sabha , actingin terms of Section 66A(1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatAlagaiah Amirthalingam was selected as the member of the Manmunai West Pradeshiya Sabha
R. SASEELAN,Returning Officer,Manmunai West Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Election Office,Batticaloa,06th August, 2018.
